title: Node.js tests file
description: Schema for backend/src/seeds/tests/node.json. Keys are question ids. Each value is an array of test entries for executeJavaScript (QuickJS sandbox). Node questions share the same runtime as JS/JS-Avanzado.

input.description: Array of args passed to the user's function, OR a single value passed directly. Sandbox wraps userCode, calls fn(...input), JSON.stringify the result, compares to expected.

expected.description: Expected JSON-serialized return value from the user's function.
